intro: Causal discovery: LiNGAM identifiability, linear disentanglement, and invariant prediction tools for recovering structure from distributional and environment-shift information.

namespace_intros.LiNGAM: Linear non-Gaussian acyclic model identification: permutation uniqueness, generalized-permutation algebra, kurtosis-based column support, and the LiNGAM identifiability theorem.
namespace_intros.InvariantPrediction.Helpers: Measure-theoretic and structural helper lemmas for invariant prediction, especially target-mechanism factorization and environment-invariance arguments.
namespace_intros.InvariantPrediction.LinearGaussian.Helpe: Linear-Gaussian invariant-prediction helpers: intervention invariance, centered-noise moments, and residual algebra for soundness and completeness proofs.
